title: A Geometric Understanding of Denoising Autoencoder with Applications to Image Denoising
abstract: arXiv:2611.19653v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Denoising autoencoders have shown strong empirical performance in recovering clean data from their noisy observations, yet their underlying statistical behavior remains underexplored. In this paper, we study denoising autoencoders under the manifold hypothesis, assuming that clean data are supported on low-dimensional smooth manifolds embedded in a high-dimensional ambient space, while noisy observations are generated by isotropic Gaussian noise. We establish generalization guarantees in three geometric scenarios: a single manifold, a pairwise separated finite union of manifolds, and a finite union of intersecting manifolds. Using local chart representations, partitions of unity, and neural network approximation, we derive upper bounds for the expected squared reconstruction error for denoising autoencoder. translated_title: 去噪自编码器的几何理解及其在图像去噪中的应用
translated_abstract: 去噪自编码器在从含噪观测中恢复干净数据方面已展现出强大的经验性能，但其背后的统计行为仍未得到充分探索。本文在流形假设下研究去噪自编码器，假设干净数据支撑在高维环境空间中嵌入的低维光滑流形上，而含噪观测由各向同性高斯噪声生成。我们在三种几何场景下建立了泛化保证：单个流形、成对分离的有限流形并集，以及相交流形的有限并集。利用局部坐标卡表示、单位分解和神经网络逼近，我们推导出 去 噪自编码器期望平方重构误差的上界。在单流形和分离并集场景中，误差由样本相关的统计项（阶为 n^{-2/(d+8)} 量级）和一个不依赖于样本的逼近项组成；在相交流形并集的更复杂场景中，我们刻画了误差在相交邻域附近的退化行为。理论结果为去噪自编码器在图像去噪任务中的成功提供了几何解释。
tldr: 本文在流形假设下首次系统建立了去噪自编码器的泛化理论，通过局部坐标卡与神经网络逼近技术在三种几何场景（单流形、分离与相交流形并集）下推导出期望重构误差的上界，为其在图像去噪中的优异表现提供了几何解释。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes generalization guarantees for denoising autoencoders under the manifold hypothesis, deriving upper bounds on expected reconstruction error in three geometric scenarios (single manifold, separated and intersecting unions of manifolds) using local charts and neural network approximation, thereby providing a geometric explanation for their success in image denoising.
